datasets.name: 52556b40
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.cloud AS region,
  u.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  u.sku_name,
  u.usage_date,
  u.billing_origin_product,
  u.product_features.is_serverless AS is_serverless,
  u.usage_quantity,
  u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(lp.pricing.effective_list.default, 0) AS total_list_cost,
  CASE
    WHEN :period = 'monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(u.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-01') AS DATE)
    WHEN :period = 'daily' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(u.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE)
  END AS usage_date_new
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time
        OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL
      )
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
WHERE
  u.usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max

columns.description: Uses billing_origin_product for Apps, Vector Search, Lakebase; sku_name for granular SKU categories
columns.expression:
CASE
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'APPS' THEN 'Databricks Apps'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'VECTOR_SEARCH' THEN 'Vector Search'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'LAKEBASE' THEN 'Lakebase'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'CLEAN_ROOM' THEN 'Clean Rooms'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` IN ('AGENT_BRICKS', 'AGENT_EVALUATION', 'SUPERVISOR_AGENT') THEN 'AI Agents'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'AI_GATEWAY' THEN 'AI Gateway'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'AI_FUNCTIONS' THEN 'AI Functions'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'ONLINE_TABLES' THEN 'Online Tables'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'PREDICTIVE_OPTIMIZATION' THEN 'Predictive Optimization'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'LAKEHOUSE_MONITORING' THEN 'Lakehouse Monitoring'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'LAKEFLOW_CONNECT' THEN 'Lakeflow Connect'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%SERVERLESS_SQL_COMPUTE%' THEN 'Serverless SQL Warehouse'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%SQL_PRO_COMPUTE%' THEN 'SQL Pro Warehouse'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%SQL_COMPUTE' THEN 'SQL Classic Warehouse'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%SERVERLESS_REAL_TIME_INFERENCE%' THEN 'Real-Time Model Serving'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%ALL_PURPOSE_SERVERLESS%' THEN 'All-Purpose Serverless'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%ALL_PURPOSE_COMPUTE%' THEN 'All-Purpose Classic'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%JOBS_SERVERLESS%' THEN 'Jobs Serverless'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%JOBS_COMPUTE%' THEN 'Jobs Classic'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%DLT%' THEN 'DLT Pipelines'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%MODEL_TRAINING%' THEN 'Model Training'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%MODEL_SERVING%' THEN 'AI Model Serving'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%CONNECTIVITY%' OR `sku_name` LIKE '%EGRESS%' THEN 'Network Traffic'
  WHEN `sku_name` LIKE '%STORAGE%' THEN 'Storage'
  ELSE COALESCE(`billing_origin_product`, 'Other')
END

columns.description: Human-readable cluster type from billing_origin_product with comprehensive mappings
columns.expression:
CASE
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` IN ('ALL_PURPOSE', 'INTERACTIVE', 'NOTEBOOKS', 'SHARED_SERVERLESS_COMPUTE') THEN 'All Purpose'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'JOBS' THEN 'Jobs'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'SQL' THEN 'SQL Warehouse'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'DLT' THEN 'DLT'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` IN ('MODEL_SERVING', 'FOUNDATION_MODEL_TRAINING', 'AI_RUNTIME', 'AI_FUNCTIONS', 'AI_GATEWAY', 'AGENT_BRICKS', 'AGENT_EVALUATION', 'SUPERVISOR_AGENT') THEN 'AI/ML'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'APPS' THEN 'Apps'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'VECTOR_SEARCH' THEN 'Vector Search'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` IN ('LAKEBASE', 'DATABASE') THEN 'Lakebase'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'CLEAN_ROOM' THEN 'Clean Room'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'NETWORKING' THEN 'Networking'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` IN ('DEFAULT_STORAGE', 'DATA_SHARING') THEN 'Storage'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` IN ('ONLINE_TABLES') THEN 'Online Tables'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` IN ('PREDICTIVE_OPTIMIZATION', 'DATA_QUALITY_MONITORING', 'LAKEHOUSE_MONITORING', 'DATA_CLASSIFICATION', 'FINE_GRAINED_ACCESS_CONTROL') THEN 'Governance & Monitoring'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'LAKEFLOW_CONNECT' THEN 'Lakeflow Connect'
  WHEN `billing_origin_product` = 'BASE_ENVIRONMENTS' THEN 'Other'
  ELSE COALESCE(`billing_origin_product`, 'Other')
END

datasets.name: c5f70e15
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.cloud AS region,
  u.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  w.workspace_url,
  u.usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
  c.cluster_name,
  u.sku_name,
  c.driver_node_type,
  c.worker_node_type,
  c.worker_count,
  c.min_autoscale_workers,
  c.max_autoscale_workers,
  c.auto_termination_minutes,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(lp.pricing.effective_list.default, 0)) AS total_cost,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_usage_quantity_dbu
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time
        OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL
      )
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM
        system.compute.clusters
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
    ) c
      ON u.workspace_id = c.workspace_id
      AND u.usage_metadata.cluster_id = c.cluster_id
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product IN ('ALL_PURPOSE', 'INTERACTIVE')
  AND u.usage_metadata.cluster_id IS NOT NULL
  AND u.usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
GROUP BY
  ALL
LIMIT CAST(:limit AS INT)

datasets.name: 028fc4c4
queryLines:
WITH ap_to_job_savings_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    ap.sku_name AS ap_sku_name,
    ROUND(
      1 - (job.pricing.effective_list.default / ap.pricing.effective_list.default),
      4
    ) AS savings_ratio
  FROM
    system.billing.list_prices ap
      INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices job
        ON job.sku_name = REPLACE(ap.sku_name, 'ALL_PURPOSE_COMPUTE', 'JOBS_COMPUTE')
        AND job.price_start_time = ap.price_start_time
  WHERE
    ap.sku_name LIKE '%ALL_PURPOSE_COMPUTE%'
    AND ap.price_end_time IS NULL
),
usage_cost AS (
  SELECT
    u.workspace_id,
    w.workspace_name,
    u.cloud AS region,
    u.usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_date,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS usage_quantity_dbu,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(lp.pricing.effective_list.default, 0)) AS total_cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time
          OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        )
      LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
        ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product IN ('ALL_PURPOSE', 'INTERACTIVE')
    AND u.usage_metadata.cluster_id IS NOT NULL
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  GROUP BY
    u.workspace_id,
    w.workspace_name,
    u.cloud,
    u.usage_metadata.cluster_id,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_date
),
clusters_latest AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    cluster_id,
    cluster_name
  FROM
    system.compute.clusters
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
job_runs_by_cluster AS (
  SELECT
    jrt.workspace_id,
    cid AS cluster_id,
    CAST(jrt.period_start_time AS DATE) AS job_run_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT jrt.run_id) AS total_job_runs
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline jrt
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(jrt.compute_ids) AS cid
  WHERE
    jrt.result_state IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(jrt.period_start_time AS DATE) BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  GROUP BY
    jrt.workspace_id,
    cid,
    CAST(jrt.period_start_time AS DATE)
),
temp AS (
  SELECT
    uc.region,
    uc.workspace_id,
    uc.workspace_name,
    uc.cluster_id,
    cl.cluster_name,
    uc.sku_name,
    j.total_job_runs,
    uc.total_cost,
    uc.total_cost * sr.savings_ratio AS potential_saving,
    uc.usage_date AS last_used_date
  FROM
    usage_cost uc
      INNER JOIN job_runs_by_cluster j
        ON uc.workspace_id = j.workspace_id
        AND uc.cluster_id = j.cluster_id
        AND uc.usage_date = j.job_run_date
      LEFT JOIN clusters_latest cl
        ON uc.workspace_id = cl.workspace_id
        AND uc.cluster_id = cl.cluster_id
      LEFT JOIN ap_to_job_savings_ratio sr
        ON uc.sku_name = sr.ap_sku_name
)
SELECT
  region,
  workspace_id,
  workspace_name,
  cluster_id,
  cluster_name,
  sku_name,
  SUM(total_job_runs) AS total_job_runs,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost), 2) AS total_cost,
  ROUND(SUM(potential_saving), 2) AS potential_saving,
  MAX(last_used_date) AS last_used_date
FROM
  temp
GROUP BY
  region,
  workspace_id,
  workspace_name,
  cluster_id,
  cluster_name,
  sku_name

datasets.name: 630ea6a2
queryLines:
WITH jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    name AS job_name
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
run_stats AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    CAST(job_id AS STRING) AS job_id,
    CAST(period_end_time AS DATE) AS usage_date,
    MAX(run_type) AS run_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS total_job_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN result_state = 'SUCCESS' THEN run_id
      END
    ) AS success_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN
          result_state IS NOT NULL
          AND result_state != 'SUCCESS'
        THEN
          run_id
      END
    ) AS failure_count
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM
        system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
      WHERE
        period_end_time IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(period_end_time AS DATE) BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, run_id ORDER BY period_end_time DESC) = 1
    )
  GROUP BY
    workspace_id,
    CAST(job_id AS STRING),
    CAST(period_end_time AS DATE)
),
node_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    CAST(start_time AS DATE) AS usage_date,
    AVG(cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent) AS avg_cpu,
    MAX(cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent) AS peak_cpu,
    AVG(cpu_wait_percent) AS avg_disk_wait,
    MAX(cpu_wait_percent) AS max_disk_wait,
    AVG(mem_used_percent) AS avg_mem,
    MAX(mem_used_percent) AS max_mem
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline
  WHERE
    CAST(start_time AS DATE) BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  GROUP BY
    cluster_id,
    CAST(start_time AS DATE)
),
billing_detail AS (
  SELECT
    u.workspace_id,
    CAST(u.usage_metadata.job_id AS STRING) AS job_id,
    u.usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_date,
    u.cloud AS region,
    u.usage_quantity AS dbu,
    u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(lp.pricing.effective_list.default, 0) AS cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time
          OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'JOBS'
    AND u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
),
billing_agg AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    sku_name,
    usage_date,
    MAX(region) AS region,
    SUM(dbu) AS total_usage_quantity_dbu,
    SUM(cost) AS total_cost
  FROM
    billing_detail
  GROUP BY
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    sku_name,
    usage_date
),
job_node_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    bd.workspace_id,
    bd.job_id,
    bd.usage_date,
    ROUND(
      SUM(nm.avg_cpu * bd.dbu)
        / NULLIF(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN nm.avg_cpu IS NOT NULL THEN bd.dbu
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS avg_cpu_utilization,
    ROUND(MAX(nm.peak_cpu), 2) AS peak_cpu_utilization,
    ROUND(
      SUM(nm.avg_disk_wait * bd.dbu)
        / NULLIF(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN nm.avg_disk_wait IS NOT NULL THEN bd.dbu
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS avg_cpu_disk_wait,
    ROUND(MAX(nm.max_disk_wait), 2) AS max_cpu_disk_wait,
    ROUND(
      SUM(nm.avg_mem * bd.dbu)
        / NULLIF(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN nm.avg_mem IS NOT NULL THEN bd.dbu
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS avg_memory_utilization,
    ROUND(MAX(nm.max_mem), 2) AS max_memory_utilization
  FROM
    billing_detail bd
      LEFT JOIN node_metrics nm
        ON bd.cluster_id = nm.cluster_id
        AND bd.usage_date = nm.usage_date
  GROUP BY
    bd.workspace_id,
    bd.job_id,
    bd.usage_date
)
SELECT
  ba.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  ba.region,
  ba.job_id,
  COALESCE(jl.job_name, ba.job_id) AS job_or_pipeline_name,
  ba.job_id AS job_id_or_pipeline_name,
  ba.sku_name,
  COALESCE(rs.run_type, 'WORKFLOW_RUN') AS run_type,
  ba.usage_date,
  ba.total_cost,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(ba.total_cost * rs.success_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS total_success_cost,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(ba.total_cost * rs.failure_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS total_failure_cost,
  ba.total_usage_quantity_dbu,
  COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) AS total_job_runs,
  COALESCE(rs.success_count, 0) AS success_count,
  COALESCE(rs.failure_count, 0) AS failure_count,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(100.0 * rs.success_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS success_percent,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(100.0 * rs.failure_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS not_successful_percent,
  COALESCE(jnm.avg_cpu_utilization, 0) AS avg_cpu_utilization,
  COALESCE(jnm.peak_cpu_utilization, 0) AS peak_cpu_utilization,
  COALESCE(jnm.avg_cpu_disk_wait, 0) AS avg_cpu_disk_wait,
  COALESCE(jnm.max_cpu_disk_wait, 0) AS max_cpu_disk_wait,
  COALESCE(jnm.avg_memory_utilization, 0) AS avg_memory_utilization,
  COALESCE(jnm.max_memory_utilization, 0) AS max_memory_utilization,
  ROUND(
    ba.total_cost * (1 - COALESCE(jnm.avg_cpu_utilization, 0) / 100) / 2,
    2
  ) AS max_potential_savings,
  CASE
    WHEN :period = 'monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(ba.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-01') AS DATE)
    WHEN :period = 'daily' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(ba.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE)
  END AS usage_date_new
FROM
  billing_agg ba
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON ba.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN jobs_latest jl
      ON ba.workspace_id = jl.workspace_id
      AND ba.job_id = CAST(jl.job_id AS STRING)
    LEFT JOIN run_stats rs
      ON ba.workspace_id = rs.workspace_id
      AND ba.job_id = rs.job_id
      AND ba.usage_date = rs.usage_date
    LEFT JOIN job_node_metrics jnm
      ON ba.workspace_id = jnm.workspace_id
      AND ba.job_id = jnm.job_id
      AND ba.usage_date = jnm.usage_date

SELECT
  ba.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  ba.region,
  ba.sku_name,
  ba.job_id AS job_id_or_pipeline_name,
  COALESCE(jl.job_name, ba.job_id) AS job_or_pipeline_name,
  COALESCE(rs.run_type, 'WORKFLOW_RUN') AS run_type,
  COALESCE(jnm.avg_cpu_utilization, 0) AS avg_cpu_utilization,
  COALESCE(jnm.peak_cpu_utilization, 0) AS peak_cpu_utilization,
  COALESCE(jnm.avg_cpu_disk_wait, 0) AS avg_cpu_disk_wait,
  COALESCE(jnm.max_cpu_disk_wait, 0) AS max_cpu_disk_wait,
  COALESCE(jnm.avg_memory_utilization, 0) AS avg_memory_utilization,
  COALESCE(jnm.max_memory_utilization, 0) AS max_memory_utilization,
  ROUND(
    ba.total_cost * (1 - COALESCE(jnm.avg_cpu_utilization, 0) / 100) / 2,
    2
  ) AS max_potential_savings,
  COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) AS total_job_runs,
  COALESCE(rs.success_count, 0) AS success_count,
  COALESCE(rs.failure_count, 0) AS failure_count,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(100.0 * rs.success_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS success_percent,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(100.0 * rs.failure_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS not_successful_percent,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(ba.total_cost * rs.success_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS total_success_cost,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(rs.total_job_runs, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(ba.total_cost * rs.failure_count / rs.total_job_runs, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS total_failure_cost,
  ba.total_usage_quantity_dbu,
  ba.total_cost
FROM
  billing_agg ba
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON ba.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN jobs_latest jl
      ON ba.workspace_id = jl.workspace_id
      AND ba.job_id = CAST(jl.job_id AS STRING)
    LEFT JOIN run_stats rs
      ON ba.workspace_id = rs.workspace_id
      AND ba.job_id = rs.job_id
    LEFT JOIN job_node_metrics jnm
      ON ba.workspace_id = jnm.workspace_id
      AND ba.job_id = jnm.job_id
LIMIT CAST(:limit AS INT)

queryLines:
SELECT
  u.cloud AS region,
  u.sku_name,
  CASE
    WHEN u.sku_name LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 'Serverless'
    WHEN u.sku_name LIKE '%PRO%' THEN 'Pro'
    ELSE 'Classic'
  END AS type_of_sql,
  u.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  u.usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
  wh.warehouse_name,
  CASE
    WHEN wh.delete_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deleted'
    ELSE 'Active'
  END AS warehouse_status,
  wh.warehouse_type,
  wh.warehouse_channel,
  wh.warehouse_size,
  wh.min_clusters,
  wh.max_clusters,
  wh.auto_stop_minutes,
  wh.tags,
  u.usage_date,
  u.usage_quantity AS usage_quantity_dbu,
  u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(lp.pricing.effective_list.default, 0) AS total_cost,
  CASE
    WHEN :period = 'monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(u.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-01') AS DATE)
    WHEN :period = 'daily' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(u.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE)
  END AS usage_date_new
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time
        OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL
      )
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM
        system.compute.warehouses
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
    ) wh
      ON u.workspace_id = wh.workspace_id
      AND u.usage_metadata.warehouse_id = wh.warehouse_id
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL'
  AND u.usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
  AND u.usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max

WITH events_with_stop AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    event_type,
    event_time,
    MIN(
      CASE
        WHEN event_type IN ('STOPPING', 'STOPPED') THEN event_time
      END
    ) OVER (
        PARTITION BY warehouse_id
        ORDER BY event_time
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) as stop_time
  FROM
    system.compute.warehouse_events
),
uptime_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    event_time as start_time,
    COALESCE(stop_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) as end_time,
    ROUND(
      (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(COALESCE(stop_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_time))
        / 3600.0,
      6
    ) as uptime_hours
  FROM
    events_with_stop
  WHERE
    event_type = 'RUNNING'
),
warehouses_latest AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    warehouse_name,
    delete_time
  FROM
    system.compute.warehouses
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  us.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  us.warehouse_id,
  COALESCE(wh.warehouse_name, us.warehouse_id) as warehouse_name,
  us.start_time,
  us.end_time,
  CASE
    WHEN wh.delete_time IS NULL THEN 'Active'
    ELSE 'Deleted'
  END as warehouse_status,
  us.uptime_hours
FROM
  uptime_sessions us
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON us.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN warehouses_latest wh
      ON us.workspace_id = wh.workspace_id
      AND us.warehouse_id = wh.warehouse_id
WHERE
  us.start_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max

WITH jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    name
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
run_results AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    run_id,
    result_state AS run_result,
    run_type,
    CAST(period_start_time AS DATE) AS usage_date
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
  WHERE
    result_state IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(period_start_time AS DATE) BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, run_id ORDER BY period_end_time DESC) = 1
),
run_costs AS (
  SELECT
    u.workspace_id,
    u.cloud AS region,
    u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id,
    u.usage_date,
    u.sku_name,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_usage_quantity_dbu,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(lp.pricing.effective_list.default, 0)) AS total_cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time
          OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'JOBS'
    AND u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  GROUP BY
    u.workspace_id,
    u.cloud,
    u.usage_metadata.job_id,
    u.usage_date,
    u.sku_name
)
SELECT
  rr.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  COALESCE(rc.region, 'Unknown') AS region,
  rr.job_id,
  rr.run_id,
  COALESCE(rr.job_id, '') AS job_id_or_pipeline_name,
  COALESCE(j.name, '') AS job_or_pipeline_name,
  COALESCE(rc.sku_name, 'Unknown') AS sku_name,
  rr.run_type,
  rr.usage_date,
  rr.run_result,
  COALESCE(rc.total_usage_quantity_dbu, 0) AS total_usage_quantity_dbu,
  COALESCE(rc.total_cost, 0) AS total_cost,
  CASE
    WHEN :period = 'monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(rr.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-01') AS DATE)
    WHEN :period = 'daily' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(rr.usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE)
  END AS usage_date_new
FROM
  run_results rr
    LEFT JOIN jobs_latest j
      ON rr.workspace_id = j.workspace_id
      AND rr.job_id = j.job_id
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON rr.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN run_costs rc
      ON rr.workspace_id = rc.workspace_id
      AND rr.job_id = rc.job_id
      AND rr.usage_date = rc.usage_date

frame.description:
SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in Databricks refers to the type of compute workload being used. This query summarizes daily DBU usage and list price cost across workspaces, grouped by high-level SKU categories such as ALL_PURPOSE, JOBS, DLT, SQL, MODEL_SERVING / INFERENCE, and CONNECTIVITY. It filters data by region and date range, and maps resource groups to environments. Hovering over the chart reveals DBU usage, cost, SKU, and date for each data point based on the selected filters.
Note: Data is only available for the past 365 days due to Databricks' retention policy, even if a longer date range is selected.
